command: cooperbench run -n coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref -s flash -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m vertex_ai/gemini-3.8-flash --agent-config configs/reference/medium.yaml --setting coop -c 4 --backend docker --git
agent_config:
# Reference agent config, thinking level: medium. Frozen on 2026-11-02: do not edit.
# Every run whose results are compared uses one of configs/reference/{low,medium,high}.yaml;
# they differ only in thinkingLevel. medium is the default (tools/run.sh uses it).
# Settings: 500 steps per agent, compaction at 128K tokens, per-turn step counter,
# $40 per-agent cost cap, containers kept alive for 10 hours.
# Reasons and evidence: notes/model_config.md#reference-setup.
# For an intervention, copy this file to configs/variants/ and add only its flag.
agent:
  cost_limit: 40.0
  step_limit: 500
  compaction_token_trigger: 128000
  step_counter: true

environment:
  container_timeout: "10h"

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: medium
      includeThoughts: true
